This uses the derivative of the same fixed-axis Rodrigues trajectory as
:func:`rigid_point_plane_signed_distance_interval`. Its preconditions on
time, angle, and the unit rotation axis are identical.

symbols.name: compute_G_matrix

symbols.docstring: scale * ∂cof(F)/∂F

symbols.name: reset_particle_state
symbols.docstring:
Copy model-default particle state into selected worlds' particles.

A non-null ``particle_q`` / ``particle_qd`` output is the caller's request to
reset that field. The shared ``_reset_world_selected()`` predicate applies
the same per-world masking as the rigid reset, mapping global particles
(``particle_world == -1``) to the mask's final slot.

symbols.name: evaluate_spring_force_and_hessian_both_vertices
symbols.docstring:
Evaluate spring force and hessian for both vertices of a spring.

Returns forces and hessians for v0 and v1 respectively.

symbols.name: accumulate_spring_force_and_hessian
symbols.docstring:
Accumulate spring forces and hessians, parallelized by springs.

Each thread handles one spring and uses atomic operations to add
forces and hessians to vertices with the current color.

symbols.name: accumulate_body_particle_attachment_force_and_hessian
symbols.docstring: Accumulate particle-body attachment forces and Hessians on particles.

symbols.name: create_vertex_triangle_division_plane_closest_pt
symbols.docstring: Build a certified soft-self VT plane whose normal points toward the vertex.

symbols.name: create_edge_edge_division_plane_closest_pt
symbols.docstring: Build a certified soft-self EE plane whose normal points toward edge 0.

symbols.name: apply_planar_truncation_parallel_by_collision
symbols.docstring: Truncate particle displacements against soft self-contact division planes, one thread group per EE or VT pair.

symbols.name: build_particle_body_contact_adjacency_active
symbols.docstring: Build linked per-particle incidence lists over the compact active contact prefix.

symbols.name: gather_particle_body_contact_force_and_hessian
symbols.docstring:
Gather all body-contact contributions for one colored particle without output atomics.

Contacts are consumed in increasing node order rather than linked-list order, so the
summation order follows the contact buffer instead of the lists' insertion order. Selection
scans the list once per consumed node (O(k^2) link reads for k contacts on one particle);
k is small in practice and the scan cost is trivial next to one contact evaluation.

symbols.name: scatter_particle_body_contact_force_and_hessian
symbols.docstring:
Accumulate body-contact forces per contact record over the active prefix.

Launched once per color per iteration with ``dim = worker_count``, a host-static grid no larger
than the capacity. Each worker strides over the active records ``tid, tid + worker_count, ...``
read from the device-side count, so the work follows the active count rather than the capacity
and the launch stays CUDA-graph safe. A record is evaluated only when one of its corners has the
active color, so the evaluations per iteration equal the per-particle gather's (one per corner
incidence) but run one record per thread. Contributions are added with atomics, so the summation
order follows scheduling; deterministic modes use
:func:`gather_particle_body_contact_force_and_hessian` instead.

symbols.name: make_solve_elasticity_tile
symbols.docstring:
Build the tiled per-particle elasticity kernel, specialized at code generation.

One kernel source serves every tiled variant: ``include_triangles`` / ``include_tets``
statically strip the triangle+edge or tetrahedron adjacency loops (the stripped
code is absent from the generated kernel, matching a hand-specialized one), and
``two_particles_per_warp`` packs two independent 16-lane particle solves into one
32-thread warp, reducing with :func:`_warp_half_reduce_sum` to preserve the legacy
16-lane reduction order bit for bit. Variants are memoized per flag combination.

symbols.name: _compliant_alm_coefficients
symbols.docstring:
Return stable ``(s, k_eff, a)`` coefficients for compliant ALM.

``s=K/(K+rho)``, ``a=rho/(K+rho)``, ``k_eff=K*a``, branched to preserve
whichever of ``s`` and ``a`` is small. A nonpositive input retires the row:
``a=1``, not the ``rho -> 0`` limit, lets the ascent clear its dual too.

symbols.name: _alm_relaxed_ascent
symbols.docstring:
Advance one compliant-ALM dual: ``lam <- s*(lam + rho*R)``.

Both branches evaluate that expression without forming ``rho*R``, which
can overflow at large rho. The increment form preserves small ``a`` when
``rho <= K``; the distributed form preserves small ``s`` otherwise.
Instantiated for scalar and ``wp.vec3`` duals.

symbols.name: _material_force_terms
symbols.docstring:
Return the ``(k, lam_eff)`` pair of a row force ``k*C + lam_eff``.

Compliant ALM gives ``(k_eff, s*dual)``, legacy ``(rho, dual)``. Coulomb
tangents bypass this: their dual is not scaled by ``s``.

symbols.name: _bilateral_auto_rho
symbols.docstring: Return ``max(H, 9K)``, ensuring ``k_eff >= 0.9K`` in each local solve.

symbols.name: _structural_joint_auto_rho
symbols.docstring: Bilateral auto-rho for a structural joint row.

symbols.name: _drive_auto_rho
symbols.docstring: Bilateral auto-rho for one drive axis.

symbols.name: _limit_auto_rho
symbols.docstring: Return support as limit rho, or zero if the row is off.

symbols.name: _contact_auto_normal_rho
symbols.docstring: Return support as contact-normal rho, or zero if the row is off.

symbols.name: _contact_auto_tangent_rho
symbols.docstring: Use tangent support, strengthened by pair structure up to the normal rho.

symbols.name: _contact_history_slot
symbols.docstring:
Return the history row of contact ``i``, or -1 when it has none.

``history_frame`` holds ``[buffer id, contact generation]`` of the contact set
the history was snapshotted from. The same contact set (same buffer, unchanged
generation) restores each row from itself. Otherwise ``match_index`` applies only
when the buffer's last collision pass matched against that snapshotted set, as
:attr:`~newton.Contacts.rigid_contact_match_generation` reports; the indices of
any other pass refer to contacts this history never stored.

symbols.docstring: Query an internal world mask whose final entry selects global entities.

symbols.docstring: Query a public reset mask whose final entry selects global entities.
